text:
Alina: Morning team — can we kick off the Sierra sandbox for marketplace packaging? Need NDA signed + packaging checklist before we publish. :wave:

Kevin: Sierra legal sent NDA v2 last night, link: https://redwood-internal/docs/partnerships/sierra/nda-v2. Question: Clause 4.2 (telemetry retention) says 180 days — Sierra asked for 90. @partners-sierra can you confirm?

partners-sierra: Confirmed, 90 days is fine from our side. We prefer retention scoped to telemetry-only, not raw request traces.

Nora: Heads up — HW lab flagged a perf delta when running the Alpine sandbox image at seq_len=2048 vs 1024. Might be KV-cache interaction. Anyone hit this in CI?

Fred: I ran a couple of quick runs on the lab VM (Sierra devkit). Observed ~8% p99 regression on the 2048 profile against our baseline. Command I used: ```./scripts/bench_runner.sh --model sierra-tiny --seq 2048 --batch 1 --warmup 200```
Logs uploaded to: https://drive.internal/redwood/sierra/sandbox-logs/1767354321

Alina: Thanks Fred — pls also drop the raw logs into the sandbox bucket and tag @eng-runtime. We also need a packaging manifest for the marketplace listing. Minimal fields: model_id, quantization, compatible_tiers, sample_rate_limit. Template below — fill and push to repo: https://git.internal/redwood/marketplace/manifests

```
model_id: sierra/tiny-v1
quantization: int8
compatible_tiers: ["hosted","dedicated"]
sample_rate_limit: "1000/min"
notes: "requires kv-cache patch"
```

Kevin: I'll follow up with Legal for the 90-day retention waiver and confirm signature chain. Also will upload signed NDA to the partnership folder. @ci-bot can you start the sandbox deployment with the new image tag?

ci-bot: Deploy job queued — job id 4821. Started at 1767354400. Estimated time 12m. Build log: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/4821

Nora: One more asks: can we get permission to include Sierra's logo and a joint blurb in the marketplace tile? We should also align on a joint announcement window. partners-sierra: Yes, we can do a joint blog and marketplace tile. Proposed embargo: April 7.

Alina: OK — I'll coordinate announcement timing with marketing and add to #announcements. Action items: 1) Fred: verify and upload full bench logs (done?), 2) Kevin: secure NDA signature + retention waiver, 3) Nora: prepare manifest + follow kv-cache triage, 4) Alina: schedule announcement + marketplace copy.

Fred: Logs uploaded to bucket and drive link above. Re-running with trace enabled now.

Kevin: NDA is in legal's e-sign queue — I pinged legal and partners.

Nora: I'll open a small PR for the manifest and add the benchmark notes. Will triage kv-cache regression with @eng-runtime tomorrow.

Alina: Great — circle back once CI completes. Thank you all :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Job 4821 completed — success. Artifact: https://ci.internal/redwood/artifacts/4821/sierra-sandbox.tar.gz

Fred: CI artifacts look clean. Early numbers confirm the p99 delta persists but we have detailed traces now.

partners-sierra: Thanks — our infra team will review traces and loop in firmware if needed. Happy to slot joint blog draft next week.

Alina: Perfect. I'll update this thread with the publish checklist and embargo calendar entry.
